svg.title: Booking platform: technical debt
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 8 components and 7 connections in 2 boundaries. Cloud account: API gateway, Booking service, Pricing service, Data zone. Data zone (in Cloud account): Bookings, Legacy inventory. Most connected: Booking service (5 connections). Nothing leads into Guest. Bottleneck: API gateway; without it the diagram falls apart. Guest (person): connects to Booking app (books). Booking app (frontend): connects to API gateway (via HTTPS). API gateway (service): connects to Booking service (routes). Booking service (service): connects to Pricing service (asks price), Bookings (via SQL), Legacy inventory (checks rooms) and Payment provider (charges, via HTTPS). Pricing service (service): no outgoing connection. Bookings (database): no outgoing connection. Legacy inventory (database): no outgoing connection. Payment provider (external system): no outgoing connection. Perspective Technical debt: low: Booking app, Pricing service; medium: API gateway, Bookings; high: Booking service; not stated: Guest, Legacy inventory, Payment provider. Debt as the owning team rated it in the last review.

polyline.title: Booking service → Pricing service: asks price
